component.title: Toast
component.purpose: Show transient, announced feedback without becoming the only recovery path.

states.description: A confirmation is visible and announced.
A consumer can enqueue feedback through the manager.

claims.statement: The viewport renders manager-owned queue and lifetime state rather than inventing notification policy.
Transient feedback has live-region semantics, explicit tone glyphs, keyboard-dismissible controls, and safe-area-aware placement.
